binary.distributed_in: ScoutMind for Windows V1 1.0.100.0 (live) and 1.0.119.0 (submitted): the same DLL (same SHA-256) was read from both MSIX packages on 2026-09-27. It is copied unmodified from the PyPI wheel below by PyInstaller's cv2 hook. The V2 Windows build installs the same wheel (requirements.txt, .github/workflows/build-standalone.yml: opencv-python-headless==4.9.0.80)

upstream_source_package.what: OpenCV's own source package for these binaries: opencv_3rdparty build_update.sh commits the output of ffmpeg/archive_src.sh to the branch <binaries branch>_src
upstream_source_package.license: per file (see the components that verify each file)

components.name: FFmpeg
components.role: statically linked into the DLL (libavcodec, libavformat, libavutil, libswscale, libswresample, libavresample, libavdevice)

components.name: libvpx
components.license: BSD-3-Clause (plus the WebM additional IP rights grant in PATENTS)

components.name: OpenH264 API headers
components.role: API headers only, compiled into OpenCV's openh264_wrapper (a run-time loader); no Cisco OpenH264 binary is bundled

components.name: OpenCV (the commit the plugin was built from)
components.role: statically linked into the DLL: modules core, imgcodecs, imgproc, videoio, the plugin project modules/videoio/misc/plugin_ffmpeg, and 3rdparty/zlib 1.3. OpenCV's own source package includes only modules/videoio/src/*ffmpeg*.hpp; the full tree is included here so the DLL can be rebuilt and relinked against a modified FFmpeg (LGPL-2.1 section 6)

components.name: opencv_3rdparty build scripts (the binaries commit, without the prebuilt DLLs)
components.license: Apache-2.0 / BSD-3-Clause style (OpenCV project scripts); license.txt carries FFmpeg's notice
components.role: the scripts used to control compilation: download_src.sh, make_mingw.sh, build_videoio_plugin.sh, the Docker image, mingw toolchain files, opencv_ffmpeg.rc and the openh264 loader wrapper

components.name: opencv-python-headless 4.9.0.80 source distribution (OpenCV 4.9.0 + the wheel build scripts)
components.license: Apache-2.0 (OpenCV and opencv-python); third-party parts under their own licences, see LICENSE-3RD-PARTY.txt
components.role: for completeness: source of cv2.pyd (OpenCV 4.9.0, dad8af6b) and of the wheel that ships the DLL (opencv-python tag 80, 8ad8ec1b)

components.name: GCC 9.3.0
components.role: toolchain: the DLL links libgcc and libstdc++ statically (-static-libgcc -static-libstdc++); OpenCV's build info names x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++-posix ver 9.3.0 (Ubuntu 20.04 gcc-mingw-w64). Ubuntu's gcc-9 patch set is not included; the runtime exception covers these libraries

components.name: Ubuntu 20.04 gcc-mingw-w64 source package (packaging of the cross compiler)

files.sha256_source: first fetch 2026-09-27 (the .dsc is OpenPGP-signed by the Ubuntu uploader; the signature was not checked)

components.role: toolchain packaging; binary version 9.3.0-7ubuntu1+22~exp1ubuntu4 or its 9.3.0-10ubuntu1 rebuild (the DLL records only 'ver 9.3.0')

components.name: Ubuntu 20.04 mingw-w64 source package (CRT, headers, winpthreads)

files.sha256_source: first fetch 2026-09-27 (the .dsc is OpenPGP-signed by the Ubuntu uploader; the signature was not checked)

components.license: ZPL-2.1 AND MIT AND LicenseRef-public-domain (see COPYING.MinGW-w64-runtime)
components.role: toolchain runtime statically linked into the DLL (mingw-w64 CRT startup code and winpthreads; the DLL contains 'Mingw-w64 runtime failure' and winpthreads/src/rwlock.c)

known_gaps: OpenCV built the DLL in an ubuntu:20.04 Docker image (ffmpeg/docker/Dockerfile) with apt packages as of 2023-12-25; the exact Ubuntu package revisions are inferred from what Ubuntu 20.04 published (gcc-mingw-w64 22~exp1ubuntu4, mingw-w64 7.0.0-2), not read from a build log. The DLL itself names only 'x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++-posix (ver 9.3.0)'.
General-purpose build tools (cmake, ninja, nasm, yasm, binutils-mingw-w64, pkg-config) are not included; they are not part of the linked work.

OpenCV's source package archives were produced by `git archive` and are shipped here byte-for-byte; each was checked file-by-file against an independent checkout of the pinned revision (see manifest.json -> assembly.results -> verification).
The 32-bit opencv_videoio_ffmpeg.dll that OpenCV builds from the same sources is not shipped by ScoutMind; the same sources cover it.
